(supposed to have in the Veda the senses of Soma, the herb itself, or its juice; juice, ghee or boiled rice, but usually taken to mean ‘food’ only by Indian lexicographers and commentators.) .²2 Grassy ground उभे यत्ते महिना शुभ्रे अन्धसी अधिक्षियन्ति पूरवः <ls>Rv. 7. 96. 2</ls>.
